test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT with respect to a binary tree?

options.text: The height of a node is the number of edges from the node to the deepest leaf
The height of a tree is a height of the root.
The depth of the node is the number of edges from the root to the node.
A full binary tree is a binary tree in which each node has exactly two children.

solution:
• A tree in which each node has exactly zero or two children is called a complete binary tree.
